build_transformer_monotonic_model: build a transformer monotonic model for simultaneous translation using TransformerModelSimulTrans with monotonic encoder and decoder
build_transformer_unidirectional_encoder: build a unidirectional transformer encoder model using TransformerUnidirectionalModel with monotonic encoder layers
extract_decoder_features: extract features from the TransformerMonotonicDecoder using extract_features with incremental state and encoder output
clear_decoder_cache: clear the incremental state cache in TransformerMonotonicDecoder layers using clear_cache with optional end_id
configure_monotonic_architecture: configure a transformer monotonic architecture using base_monotonic_architecture with encoder unidirectional settings
